name: OORecover
description: Recover C++ classes (vtables, Itanium and MSVC RTTI, members, inheritance, typed vtables) via MLIL SSA analysis
longdescription: OOAnalyzer-style C++ object recovery built on Binary Ninja analysis. Finds vtables via symbols, RTTI headers and pointer scans (Itanium and MSVC ABIs, 32 and 64 bit), collects this-pointer facts from MLIL SSA (vtable installs, member accesses, constructor chains, allocations), and applies structures with embedded bases, typed vtable structures, named methods and typed this parameters. Classes without any vtable are recovered from their mangled member functions (members, constructors, embedded bases). Builds without RTTI keep their real class names when symbols survive: from the vtable symbol, whose group of tables also gives the sub-object offsets, or from the constructor and destructor symbols that store each table. Virtual calls are resolved to their implementations (xrefs from call sites), including calls through parameters of free functions and non-virtual members. Methods returning a structure by value get a native hidden-pointer return location, with this in the following register. Consistency checks withdraw contradictory conclusions (members past the object, folded functions, inheritance cycles). Existing class types are kept; Binary Ninja's own RTTI vtable types are updated in place under their names and its symbols are preserved. Every run is one undo action.
author: Monty
